title: Counter label, singular vs plural
summary: After adding one to-do, the counter should read "1 item left". The broken page always says "items".
what_differs: The broken page always renders "items", so one to-do shows "1 items left".
steps: Type "buy some cheese" into the "What needs to be done?" box and press Enter.

wordings.text: Verify the todo counter reads "1 item left".
Verify the exact visible text of the todo counter is "1 item left".
